name: @epoch/ai-experience
description: Epoch AI Experience v1 — the typed AI-collaboration domain model (Work Order W015, experience layer): tenant-scoped collaboration-session descriptors with human/agent role grants, agent presence/focus states, the typed interaction-intent vocabulary (subsets of the Universal interactions), takeover/release transitions with provenance, Engineering Moment records (content-addressed, shareable/replayable), collaboration event adapters over the W010 event shapes, and deterministic projection folds. Semantics as typed data over the event-sourced substrate — never a second authority, never event storage, never a transport.
